command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_*conduction.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Unit heat capacity, wall and ambient conductances 2 and 3 W/K, both at 305 K, P=2^-50 W. At t=0.5 s compare temperature excess / P to (1-exp(-5t))/5 and to (1-r^n)/5, r=(1-2.5dt)/(1+2.5dt). Compare wall and ambient heat to their discrete analytical integrals, and chained steps with a single call on the same grid. End fields are also required to match bit-for-bit. Applies to cell-only restart; dynamic walls have independent state.
